segments.title: Groundwork for PokemonController and PokemonModule
context: This change adds an API that lists, reads, creates, updates and deletes Pokemon, and asks for the same API key as the trainer API. A request that names a Pokemon or a trainer that does not exist gets a 404, and a create request with an unknown type, the same type twice, an empty name or a level outside 1 to 100 gets a 422.

nodes.impactReason: `bootstrap()` in `src/main.ts` creates the server from `AppModule`, which [now imports `PokemonModule`](code:src/app.module.ts#L16), so the server also answers the five routes of `/api/pokemon`. With [`autoLoadEntities` and `synchronize` set](code:src/app.module.ts#L13), TypeORM also creates the `pokemon` table when the server starts.

[`startApp()` compiles its testing module from `AppModule`](code:test/app.ts#L6), which [now imports `PokemonModule`](code:src/app.module.ts#L16), so the app of every end-to-end test also answers the routes of `/api/pokemon`.

waypoints.title: Added `PokemonModule` to the imports of the app
waypoints.reading: The author modified the module `AppModule` to import `PokemonModule`, so Nest registers [`PokemonController`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L10) and [`PokemonService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L11) when the app starts. `bootstrap()` in `src/main.ts` and [`startApp()`](code:test/app.ts#L5-10) both build the app from `AppModule`, so the server and the end-to-end tests answer `/api/pokemon`. `autoLoadEntities` adds [the `Pokemon` entity of `PokemonModule`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L9) to the connection, and `synchronize` creates its table.

waypoints.title: Added the list of the 18 Pokemon types
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `POKEMON_TYPES` that holds the 18 type names in lower case. [`CreatePokemonDto` checks `primaryType` and `secondaryType` against it with `@IsIn()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L29-35), so a create request with the type `"thunder"` gets a 422. [`UpdatePokemonDto` does not read it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L54-60).

waypoints.title: Added the `TypesDiffer` constraint for the same type twice
waypoints.reading: The author added a class-validator constraint `TypesDiffer`, named `typesDiffer`, with a method that compares the two types and a method that returns the error message. [`CreatePokemonDto` puts it on `secondaryType` with `@Validate(TypesDiffer)`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L34), so a create request with `"fire"` as both types gets a 422.

waypoints.title: Added `validate()` to compare the two types
waypoints.reading: The author added a method `validate()` that returns `false` when `secondaryType` equals the `primaryType` of the body. class-validator passes the whole body as `object`, and the method reads it as a [`CreatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#CreatePokemonDto). [`@IsOptional()` on `secondaryType`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L32) skips the method for `null`, so a Pokemon with one type gets no error.

waypoints.title: Added the error message for the same type twice
waypoints.reading: The author added a method `defaultMessage()` that returns `"a Pokemon cannot have the same type twice"`. class-validator calls it when `validate()` returns `false`, and [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) puts the message in the body of the 422.

waypoints.title: Added `CreatePokemonDto` for the body of a create request
waypoints.reading:
The author added a class `CreatePokemonDto` that:

- requires a `name` of 1 to 40 characters and a `primaryType` from `POKEMON_TYPES`
- sets `level` to `5` when the body leaves it out, and requires a whole number from 1 to 100 otherwise
- sets `secondaryType` and `trainerId` to `null` when the body leaves them out
- runs `TypesDiffer` on a `secondaryType` that is not `null`

[`add()` takes its body as a `CreatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L22), so [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) returns a 422 for a body that breaks one of these rules, before [`PokemonService.create()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.create) runs.
waypoints.coreChange: This is the contract of `POST /api/pokemon`: every body passes these rules before [`PokemonService.create()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.create) writes a row, and [the two new tests](code:test/pokemon.e2e-spec.ts#L6-22) check two of them.

children.title: Added the `name` field with a length of 1 to 40
children.reading: The author added a field `name` that takes a text of 1 to 40 characters. A longer name gets a 422, so every name fits [the `length: 40` column of `Pokemon`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.entity.ts#L9-10).

children.title: Added the `level` field with a range of 1 to 100
children.reading: The author added a field `level` that takes a whole number from 1 to 100, and is `5` when the body leaves it out. [A new test sends a level of 101 and expects a 422](code:test/pokemon.e2e-spec.ts#L17-21).

children.title: Added the required `primaryType` field
children.reading: The author added a field `primaryType` that takes one of the names in [`POKEMON_TYPES`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#POKEMON_TYPES). A body that leaves it out, or sends `"thunder"`, gets a 422, which [a new test checks](code:test/pokemon.e2e-spec.ts#L8-12).

children.title: Added the optional `secondaryType` field
children.reading: The author added a field `secondaryType` that is `null` by default. When it is set, it takes one of the names in [`POKEMON_TYPES`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#POKEMON_TYPES), and [`TypesDiffer.validate()` returns `false`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L10-12) when it equals `primaryType`, so the body gets a 422.

children.title: Added the optional `trainerId` field
children.reading: The author added a field `trainerId` that is `null` by default, and takes a whole number when it is set. [`PokemonService.create()` loads the trainer when `trainerId` is not `null`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L27), so a new Pokemon never names a trainer that does not exist.

waypoints.title: Added `UpdatePokemonDto` for the body of an update request
waypoints.reading: The author added a class `UpdatePokemonDto` with [the five fields of `CreatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L20-39), each marked `@IsOptional()`. [`PokemonService.update()` copies the body onto the stored row with `Object.assign()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L34), so a PATCH changes only the fields its body names. It keeps the length of `name` and the range of `level`, checks the two types with `@IsString()` only, and has no `TypesDiffer`.

findings.title: `UpdatePokemonDto` lets a PATCH store a type outside `POKEMON_TYPES`
findings.reading: [`UpdatePokemonDto` checks `primaryType` and `secondaryType` with `@IsString()` only](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L54-60), where [`CreatePokemonDto` checks them with `@IsIn(POKEMON_TYPES)`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L29-33). [`PokemonService.update()` copies every field of the body onto the row and saves it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L34), so a PATCH stores a type that a POST gets a 422 for.
trace: [`@IsString()` passes for `"thunder"`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L55), so [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) returns no error.
[`this.pokemon.save(Object.assign(pokemon, { primaryType: "thunder" }))`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L34) stores `"thunder"`, and the response is a 200 with `"primaryType": "thunder"`.

findings.title: `UpdatePokemonDto` passes `null` to columns that are `NOT NULL`
findings.reading: [`@IsOptional()` skips every check of a field that is `null`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L43), so a body with `"name": null` gets no error, and the same holds for `level` and `primaryType`. [`PokemonService.update()` copies the `null` onto the row](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L34), but [the `name` column of `Pokemon` is `NOT NULL`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.entity.ts#L9-10), because its `@Column()` does not set `nullable: true`. The save throws `QueryFailedError`, which no exception filter of the app catches, so the client gets a 500 in place of a 422. The fix also adds `ValidateIf` to [the import from `class-validator`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L1).
trace: [`@IsOptional()` skips `@IsString()` and `@Length(1, 40)` for `null`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L43-45), so [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) returns no error.
[`this.pokemon.save(pokemon)`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L34) throws `QueryFailedError: NOT NULL constraint failed: pokemon.name`, and Nest returns a 500.

children.title: Added an optional `name` field with a length of 1 to 40
children.reading: The author added a field `name` that the body can leave out, and that takes a text of 1 to 40 characters when it is set, as [`CreatePokemonDto.name`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L20-22) does.

children.title: Added an optional `level` field with a range of 1 to 100
children.reading: The author added a field `level` that the body can leave out, and that takes a whole number from 1 to 100 when it is set, as [`CreatePokemonDto.level`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L24-27) does. A PATCH with a level of 101 gets a 422.

children.title: Added an optional `primaryType` field that takes any text
children.reading: The author added a field `primaryType` that the body can leave out, and that takes any text when it is set. [`CreatePokemonDto.primaryType`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L29-30) takes only a name from `POKEMON_TYPES`, so a PATCH can store a type that a POST gets a 422 for.

children.title: Added an optional `secondaryType` field that takes any text
children.reading: The author added a field `secondaryType` that the body can leave out or set to `null`, and that takes any text otherwise. It has neither the `@IsIn(POKEMON_TYPES)` nor the `@Validate(TypesDiffer)` of [`CreatePokemonDto.secondaryType`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L32-35).

children.title: Added an optional `trainerId` field
children.reading: The author added a field `trainerId` that the body can leave out, set to `null` or set to a whole number. [`PokemonService.update()` loads the trainer only when `trainerId` is a number](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L33), so `{"trainerId": null}` removes the trainer of a Pokemon.

waypoints.title: Added the `Pokemon` entity for the `pokemon` table
waypoints.reading: The author added a TypeORM entity `Pokemon` that maps the `pokemon` table. [`PokemonModule` registers it with `TypeOrmModule.forFeature()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L9), and [`PokemonService` receives its repository](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L12), which reads and writes every row of the API. [`synchronize: true`](code:src/app.module.ts#L13) creates the table when the app starts.

children.title: Added the `id` primary key
children.reading: The author added an `id` column that the database generates on insert. [`PokemonService.find()` loads a row by it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L21).

children.title: Added the `name` column of up to 40 characters
children.reading: The author added a `name` column of type `varchar(40)` that is `NOT NULL`, because `@Column()` does not set `nullable`. Its length is the length that [`CreatePokemonDto.name`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L20-22) takes.

children.title: Added the `level` column
children.reading: The author added a `level` column of whole numbers that is `NOT NULL`. The column has no range: [`CreatePokemonDto.level`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L24-27) keeps the value from 1 to 100.

children.title: Added the `primaryType` column of up to 10 characters
children.reading: The author added a `primaryType` column of type `varchar(10)` that is `NOT NULL`. The longest names in [`POKEMON_TYPES`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#POKEMON_TYPES), `"electric"` and `"fighting"`, have eight characters, so every known type fits.

children.title: Added the nullable `secondaryType` column
children.reading: The author added a `secondaryType` column of type `varchar(10)` with `nullable: true`, so the column is `NULL` for a Pokemon with one type. It names its `type`, because TypeORM cannot read `varchar` from the union `string | null`.

children.title: Added the nullable `trainerId` column
children.reading: The author added a nullable `trainerId` column of type `int`. [`PokemonService.list()` filters on it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L17), so `GET /api/pokemon?trainerId=1` returns the Pokemon of trainer 1.

children.title: Added the `trainer` relation on the `trainerId` column
children.reading: The author added a many-to-one relation to [`Trainer`](code:src/trainers/trainer.entity.ts#L3-13) that joins on the `trainerId` column, so TypeORM creates a foreign key from `pokemon.trainerId` to `trainers.id`. No code of the change loads the relation: [`PokemonService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService) reads and writes `trainerId` alone.

waypoints.title: Added `PokemonService` for the Pokemon of the API
waypoints.reading: The author added an injectable class `PokemonService` with one method per handler of [`PokemonController`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#PokemonController). [`PokemonModule` lists it in `providers`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L11), so Nest creates it once and passes it to [the constructor of the controller](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L9).

waypoints.title: Added the constructor that receives the repository and `TrainersService`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constructor that takes the TypeORM repository of [`Pokemon`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.entity.ts#Pokemon) through `@InjectRepository(Pokemon)`, and [`TrainersService`](code:src/trainers/trainers.service.ts#L8-25). Nest passes both, because [`PokemonModule` imports `TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Pokemon])` and `TrainersModule`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L9), and [`TrainersModule` exports `TrainersService`](code:src/trainers/trainers.module.ts#L11).

waypoints.title: Added `list()` to load the Pokemon, sorted by name
waypoints.reading: The author added a method `list()` that loads every `Pokemon` ordered by `name`, and only the Pokemon of one trainer when `trainerId` is not `undefined`. [`PokemonController.readAll()` returns its list](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L13) as the body of `GET /api/pokemon`.

waypoints.title: Added `find()` to load one Pokemon or throw `NotFoundError`
waypoints.reading: The author added a method `find()` that loads a row by its `id` with `findOneBy()`, and throws `NotFoundError("pokemon", pokemonId)` when there is none. [`PokemonController.read()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L18), [`update()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L32) and [`remove()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L38) call it, so all three return a 404 for an unknown id through [`NotFoundFilter`](code:src/errors.ts#L13-19).

waypoints.title: Added `create()` to insert a new Pokemon
waypoints.reading:
The author added a method `create()` that:

- throws `NotFoundError` through [`TrainersService.find()`](code:src/trainers/trainers.service.ts#L16-20) when the body names a trainer that does not exist
- builds a `Pokemon` from every field of the body with `this.pokemon.create()`
- inserts the row with `save()`, which sets its `id`

[`PokemonController.add()` returns the saved row](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L23) as the body of the 201.

waypoints.title: Added `update()` to write the changed fields onto a Pokemon
waypoints.reading:
The author added a method `update()` that:

- loads the Pokemon with [`find()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.find), which throws `NotFoundError` for an unknown id
- throws `NotFoundError` through [`TrainersService.find()`](code:src/trainers/trainers.service.ts#L16-20) when the body sets a trainer that does not exist
- copies every field of the body onto the row with `Object.assign()`, and saves the row

[`PokemonController.edit()` returns the saved row](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L28), so a PATCH with `{"level": 12}` changes the level and nothing else.
waypoints.coreChange: This is the only code that changes a stored Pokemon: every field of a PATCH body is copied onto the row here, so the checks of [`UpdatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#UpdatePokemonDto) decide what an update can write.

waypoints.title: Added `remove()` to delete a stored Pokemon
waypoints.reading: The author added a method `remove()` that loads the row with [`find()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.find) and deletes it. [`PokemonController.remove()` calls it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L34), so a DELETE of an unknown id gets a 404 and a DELETE of a stored id gets a 204.

waypoints.title: Added two tests that send a create request with a wrong field
waypoints.reading:
The author added a test file that sends `POST /api/pokemon` with the API key from `API_KEY` to the app that [`startApp()` builds from `AppModule`](code:test/app.ts#L5-10), and:

- `rejects an unknown type` sends the type `"thunder"`, which [`@IsIn(POKEMON_TYPES)` on `primaryType`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L29) does not take, and expects a 422
- `rejects a level above 100` sends a level of 101, which [`@Max(100)` on `level`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#L26) does not take, and expects a 422

Both get the 422 from [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) before [`add()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L21-24) runs, so neither test reaches `PokemonService`.

context: This segment adds the routes that list, read, create, update and delete Pokemon, and asks for the same API key as the trainer routes.

traceDiagram.title: Pokemon API requests flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `AppModule` imports `PokemonModule`, and how `PokemonController` registers the routes of `/api/pokemon` and `/api/pokemon/:pokemonId`. It also shows what happens when a request reaches one of the routes, and how the Pokemon reaches the database through the TypeORM repository of `Pokemon`.

Nest then loads each module of `imports`, and [`PokemonModule` is one of them](code:src/app.module.ts#L16).

Three paths reach this method:

- When a client sends `GET /api/pokemon/:pokemonId`, [`read()` calls it](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L18).

waypoints.title: Added `PokemonController` for the routes of `/api/pokemon`
waypoints.reading: The author added a controller `PokemonController` at the path `pokemon` that runs `ApiKeyGuard` before every handler. [`ApiKeyGuard` throws `UnauthorizedException` for a wrong `x-api-key` header](code:src/security.ts#L9), so the Pokemon routes return a 401 as the trainer routes of `src/trainers/trainers.controller.ts` do. [`PokemonModule` registers the controller](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L10), and the global prefix `api` that `bootstrap()` in `src/main.ts` sets puts both routes under `/api/pokemon`.

waypoints.title: Added the constructor that receives `PokemonService`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constructor that takes [`PokemonService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService) as `pokemon`. Nest passes the one instance that [`PokemonModule` lists in `providers`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.module.ts#L11), and each handler of the class calls one of its methods.

waypoints.title: Added `readAll()` for `GET /api/pokemon`
waypoints.reading: The author added a route handler `readAll()` that returns [`PokemonService.list()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.list). `ParseIntPipe` reads `trainerId` from the query string as a number, or as `undefined` when it is left out, so `GET /api/pokemon?trainerId=1` returns the Pokemon of trainer 1 and `GET /api/pokemon` returns all of them.

waypoints.title: Added `read()` for `GET /api/pokemon/:pokemonId`
waypoints.reading: The author added a route handler `read()` that returns the Pokemon that [`PokemonService.find()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.find) loads. For an id with no row, `find()` throws `NotFoundError`, and [`NotFoundFilter` returns a 404](code:src/errors.ts#L17) with `{"detail": "pokemon 7 not found"}`.

waypoints.title: Added `add()` for `POST /api/pokemon`
waypoints.reading: The author added a route handler `add()` that passes the [`CreatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#CreatePokemonDto) body to [`PokemonService.create()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.create), and returns the new Pokemon with a 201. A body that breaks a rule of `CreatePokemonDto` gets a 422 from [the global `ValidationPipe`](code:src/app.module.ts#L19) before the handler runs, which [the two new tests](code:test/pokemon.e2e-spec.ts#L6-22) check.

waypoints.title: Added `edit()` for `PATCH /api/pokemon/:pokemonId`
waypoints.reading: The author added a route handler `edit()` that passes the id and the [`UpdatePokemonDto`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.dto.ts#UpdatePokemonDto) body to [`PokemonService.update()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.update), and returns the updated Pokemon with a 200. It answers `PATCH`, so a client sends only the fields it changes.

waypoints.title: Added `remove()` for `DELETE /api/pokemon/:pokemonId`
waypoints.reading: The author added a route handler `remove()` that calls [`PokemonService.remove()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.remove), and returns a 204 with no body because of `@HttpCode(204)`. For an id with no row, [`PokemonService.find()`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService.find) throws `NotFoundError`, so the client gets a 404.

waypoints.title: Added `PokemonModule` for the Pokemon API
waypoints.reading: The author added a Nest module `PokemonModule` that registers [`PokemonController`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#PokemonController), [`PokemonService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService) and the repository of [`Pokemon`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.entity.ts#Pokemon). [`AppModule` imports it](code:src/app.module.ts#L16), so the routes of `/api/pokemon` exist when the app starts.

children.title: Added the imports of the `Pokemon` repository and `TrainersModule`
children.reading:
The author added two imports to the module:

- `TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Pokemon])`, so [`PokemonService` receives the repository of `Pokemon`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L12)
- `TrainersModule`, so [`PokemonService` receives `TrainersService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#L13), which [`TrainersModule` exports](code:src/trainers/trainers.module.ts#L11)

children.title: Added `PokemonController` to the controllers of the module
children.reading: The author added a `controllers` list that holds [`PokemonController`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#PokemonController), so Nest creates the controller and registers [its five route handlers](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L11-35) when the app starts.

children.title: Added `PokemonService` to the providers of the module
children.reading: The author added a `providers` list that holds [`PokemonService`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.service.ts#PokemonService), so Nest creates one `PokemonService` and passes it to [the constructor of `PokemonController`](code:src/pokemon/pokemon.controller.ts#L9).
